question: At every published NGC 3447 Cepheid coordinate, what do the official F090W and F150W mosaics contain before a source detector is allowed to delete a row?

frozenInputs.targetTable: The 142-row version-of-record NGC 3447 MRT pinned in RC65

coordinateTransform.definition: Add x/cos(dec)/3600 degrees to right ascension and y/3600 degrees to declination.
coordinateTransform.provenance: Frozen on even author IDs in RC67; it is not re-estimated in RC68.

requiredFields: mosaic pixel coordinate and edge distance
segmentation occupancy inside the aperture and background annulus
ledgerGate.pass: All 142 targets have one explicit row in each band; no target is dropped because its center label is zero, its nearest catalog distance exceeds 0.3 arcsec, or its flux is non-positive.
ledgerGate.fail: A coordinate falls outside the product footprint or frozen edge margin, has no contributing exposure, or cannot be mapped without an outcome-dependent astrometric choice.
ledgerGate.nextOnFailure: Preserve the row with a typed failure state and open a preregistered transform or exposure-level branch; never delete it.

reference.name: Pipeline-metadata 70-percent aperture
reference.background: Sigma-clipped median of finite annulus pixels outside all segmentation labels
reference.error: Quadrature of ERR with the same fractional weights; reported separately from empirical annulus noise

sensitivity.name: Pipeline-metadata 50-percent aperture
sensitivity.background: Sigma-clipped median of finite annulus pixels outside all segmentation labels
sensitivity.purpose: Expose aperture and local-background sensitivity; it is not an independent DOLPHOT reduction.

measurementReceipts.units: SCI and ERR are converted from MJy/sr to Jy per output pixel using PIXAR_SR. Positive corrected flux is also expressed as AB and Vega magnitude using the catalog metadata offsets F090W=0.48407587 and F150W=1.2045733; non-positive values remain numeric fluxes with null magnitudes.
measurementReceipts.validationResidual: For each reduction, subtract the even-ID median of forced F150W Vega magnitude minus the published phase-corrected F150W. Apply that one frozen additive calibration to odd IDs and compare tidal-minus-spiral residual means. This descriptive contrast mixes phase, aperture, and crowding and is not a distance estimate.

sealedAdjudicands: number of complete target-first rows and valid-coverage rows by band
center segmentation occupancy by component and catalog-recovery state
fraction of catalog misses whose coordinate lies inside a nonzero segmentation island
forced-flux signal-to-noise by component and catalog-recovery state
reference-versus-sensitivity flux agreement and sign discordance
odd-ID component contrasts in F150W forced-minus-published magnitude, reported only where both magnitudes are finite
claimBoundary: PHOST-PF1A can distinguish no coverage, no segmented island, blended-island membership, and measurable local flux at fixed coordinates. It cannot reproduce DOLPHOT multi-exposure PSF photometry, phase corrections, artificial-star debiasing, the 154-to-144-to-142 author selection, or a global H0 fit.
stopRules: Do not tune the RC67 coordinate transform on odd IDs.
Do not treat a segmentation label as an author stable ID.
Do not call an i2d aperture magnitude a Cepheid mean magnitude or a DOLPHOT reproduction.
Do not infer a crowding correction when aperture and annulus choices disagree materially.
Do not transport any component contrast into H0 without phase, PSF, artificial-star, and covariance closure.
